as_told.title: $2 billion offer to buy Greer's CSETI

plain: This story is about an offer that Steven Greer, a UFO researcher, says he received from a US Army general named Albert Stubblebine. Greer says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that in 1992 Stubblebine offered him two billion dollars. He tells it while mentioning another host, Patrick Bet-David. Michels tells it again in a later episode, without the money or the date. In his version, Stubblebine was the first on the scene around Greer, apparently trying to recruit him into some kind of government program. It is told because, if true, it would mean a senior military figure tried to bring a leading UFO activist inside with an enormous offer.
